court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Sumeet Subhash Kumar Thr Poa Subhash ... vs Shirin Sumeet Kumar

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Sumeet Subhash Kumar Through PoA ] Subhash Ramruch Kumar

facts_of_case: Parties are desirous of prosecuting their divorce petition and consent to convert it into a petition for mutual consent under Section 13-B of the Hindu Marriage Act.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking divorce to establish that the marriage has been broken down irretrievably.
legal_principles.held: In view of the above, it is clear that the parties have failed to establish any material difference in their lifestyle or living conditions which could be a ground for divorce.

legal_principles.principle: A petition for divorce can be converted into a petition for mutual consent divorce under Section 13-B of the Hindu Marriage Act.
legal_principles.held: The parties have arrived at a consensus to convert their divorce petition into a petition for mutual consent divorce under Section 13-B of the Hindu Marriage Act.

outcome.final_order: Consensus arrived at for converting the said petition into a petition for mutual consent under Section 13-B of the Hindu Marriage Act.

use_for_drafting: drafting a joint petition for divorce
advising on spousal rights and property settlement
